names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 20 Νοεμβρίου, «Άγιοι Γεϊθαζέτ ο ευνούχος, Σασάνης, Νοηλμάρης και Ζαρουαντίνης», with the rank words left off.

Read out of the title on the name link behind his place in the clause for 20 ноября ст. ст., «Азат Гадиабский (Персидский), мч.», with the grade words left off; the clause itself declines the bare forename. The Cyrillic forename is Азат where the Greek folder’s is Γεϊθαζέτ, and the row’s note says on what the two were joined. `.tmp/foldchk.py` reports no folder holding this form.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 20 ноября ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Нирсы еп. и Иосифа, ученика его, Иоанна, Саверия, Исакия и Ипатия, епископов Персидских; мч. Азата скопца, Сасония, Феклы, Анны и иных многих мужей и жен, в Персиде пострадавших (343).»

attestations.note: The Greek and the Russian name him differently and the match is made on the epithet and the company, not on the letters. saint.gr has Γεϊθαζέτ ο ευνούχος first of a group of four; the Russian clause has «мч. Азата скопца» first of a group whose next name is Сасоний, which is saint.gr’s Σασάνης in the same second place. «Скопец» is «ο ευνούχος». The forenames differ — Azat against Geithazat — and nothing read reconciles them; the eunuch, the place in the company and the day do.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (2 October 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 20ης Νοεμβρίου — «Άγιοι Γεϊθαζέτ ο ευνούχος, Σασάνης, Νοηλμάρης και Ζαρουαντίνης»

attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/3050/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 20 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The line enumerates four men by name, so there is a folder for each, and the four share one life. The first of them is **not** the corpus's `gothazat-companion-of-simeon`, who carries a venerated Greek row on 17 April and was beheaded with Simeon of Persia and eleven hundred and fifty others: this is another page, another day, another death — all four here are run through with spears for refusing the Persian Sun — and two entries on one calendar are two commemorations, so that row is left exactly where it is. The page gives no year, no city and no king by name, so no `dates` object is proposed. No hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (2 October 2026).

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru closes the clause for 20 ноября ст. ст. with «(343)» and closes its life page with «(+ 343)», and the page gives no year of birth and no other date. The year is the whole company’s, not this one figure’s: the page gives it once, at the end of a sentence that gathers «Сасоний, Фекла, Анна и многие другие мужчины и женщины».
